model.notes: Same checkpoint/revision for agent (all arms), user simulator, NL-assertion judge, and representation extractor.

software.chat_template: tokenizer_config.json chat_template of the frozen revision

benchmark.name: tau2-bench text mode (half-duplex)
benchmark.agent_implementation: cloq_agent (tau2 llm_agent + frozen context policy + decision-state logging; no other change)
benchmark.nl_assertion_judge: local frozen BF16 user-simulator server (same model), temperature 0
secondary_endpoints: tau2_reward (task success incl. COMMUNICATE / NL judged by frozen local judge)
benchmark.retry_note: deterministic serving makes retries of a deterministic failure pointless; one retry kept for transient errors. Multi-attempt decision logs: analysis keeps the final trajectory_id per task.

generation_user.context_policy: none (user simulator context is never truncated; identical across arms)

context_policy.history_rule: keep the most recent history units within budget; drop the oldest units after the first user request; a unit is one user message, one assistant text message, or one assistant tool-call message together with all of its tool results; never split a tool call from its results

serving.checkpoint_format: fake-quant BF16 safetensors (dequantized W4 weights); served through the identical BF16 vLLM path as the BF16 arm

quantization.source_checkpoint: original BF16 revision for every arm (never re-quantize a quantized checkpoint)

stress_setting.trigger: W4 degradation < 1pp AND no first-divergence/occupancy effect

calibration.counting_rule: non-padding prompt tokens of the exact stored model input (post context policy), no generated tokens

arms.static: initial decision states of calibration tasks (system + tools + greeting + first user request), sampled until budget
arms.fp_traj: BF16-agent decision states from calibration tasks, uniform within depth quartile, until budget
arms.cloq: 50% tokens FP-Traj states + 50% tokens Q0-visited states (Q0 = FP-Traj W4 run closed-loop on calibration tasks), each depth-stratified; requantized from BF16

task_split.selection_rule: BF16-only pilot; a task is usable iff its BF16 episode terminated normally (user_stop or agent_stop) -- episodes hitting the step cap or the tool-error cap have no well-defined horizon; stratify usable tasks by BF16 horizon (number of agent decision steps) quartile; within-quartile random with seed 2024; calibration and evaluation task IDs disjoint; if fewer usable tasks than the target, keep the 40/60 ratio.
task_split.horizon_definition: number of BF16 agent decision points (LLM calls) in the BF16 trajectory
task_split.target_note: airline: all 50 tasks (20/30). retail: all 114 tasks at the plan's 40/60 ratio (46/68) instead of the 20/30 target, decided 2026-09-15 before any quantized run to increase held-out power; usable = stable BF16 run.

representation.primary: final-layer hidden state (post final norm) at the last prompt token (assistant generation boundary)
representation.secondary: mean final-layer hidden state over the tokens of the most recent tool/user observation message

analysis.support_distance: min over calibration contexts of 1 - cosine(phi(x), phi(z))
analysis.tool_call_normalization: tool name + json.dumps(arguments, sort_keys=True) after stripping whitespace in string values and canonicalising numbers (int-valued floats -> int)

evaluation_type_at_run: all_ignore_basis (DB/ACTION/COMMUNICATE computed; NL assertions judged offline by cloq.nl_judge)
